fixed_probe_policy.ordinary: no Q95-positive hour in the 24-lead window
fixed_probe_policy.sustained: at least six consecutive Q95-positive leads
fixed_probe_policy.onset: first Q95-positive lead is 1..6 and no run reaches six leads
fixed_probe_policy.other_pattern: excluded from the three primary probe strata; support is counted
fixed_probe_policy.diversity_order: round-robin station/event groups; then origin_time and sample_id
fixed_probe_policy.required_report_case_ids: include the accepted bank manifest report cases when they fit the 24-origin cap

cache.fit_role: unique rows from accepted C exposure indices [0:1000, :64], sorted global fit index
cache.select_role: complete CN select view, source bank order
cache.dtype: float32 for model outputs; float64 for fit-only z statistics
cache.z_normalization: fit-only mean and population standard deviation; denominator max(std,1e-6)
cache.x_y_storage: read-only references to accepted bank; cache stores source role, sample_id, global index and source checksums

training_report: training_report_v1 learning/prediction/risk pages; numerical health/interventions nonempty
formal_initialization: fresh original C+A; never phase1 smoke checkpoints
formal_budget: shared1200s minus actual phase1 cumulative, separately accepted phase1 unaccounted wrapper seconds, explicit parent-audit seconds, formal wrapper import/prepare and reserved final audit
phase1_artifacts: required CLI, actual accepted cache receipt only
primary_score: original China station/source-event/origin equal, full24h Q95/Q99 Brier
prediction_protocol: source China row order, batch32, seed+first_index (600002 selection;900002 final)
selected0: reuse original A256 predictions/conditions with exact hashes; no retained gate improvement
phase_score_definition: Exact accepted audit239af24 phases/summarize: canonical station+source event unique hourly timeline, gap blocks, first3 known-entry hours and complete>6h run middle excluding first/last3; subset hierarchy weights per lead; matching threshold channel
phase1_unaccounted_wrapper_seconds_defin: nonnegative difference: sum of all phase1-related run_record wall times minus phase1 budget cumulative compute seconds; supplied by independent accepted receipt, separate from parent audit
